verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and doesn't hold user data the way a data product would. Its own desktop app does let users chat with models directly inside the product, and a hands-on user reports multimodal input works there. That is the closest evidence of getting AI output from your own content in-product, but nothing describes proactive insights or suggestions drawn from user data. Missing for 10: documented analysis of user files or data inside the app, proactive insights or suggestions, first-party docs describing the feature, and independent corroboration beyond one community comment.
